project_type: Vite + React 18 + TypeScript + Tailwind web app (apps/macros-web) inside a monorepo; the repo root is an Expo React Native app that must NOT be touched
build_system: npm scripts via Vite; run from apps/macros-web
test_framework: Vitest + @testing-library/react (jsdom env, renderHook for hooks); coverage via @vitest/coverage-v8 with 80% thresholds (lines/functions/branches/statements)
build_command: cd apps/macros-web && npm run build  (tsc && vite build)
test_command: cd apps/macros-web && npm run test:coverage  (vitest run --coverage)
verification_instructions: From apps/macros-web: npm run typecheck; npm run lint; npm run test:coverage (>=80%); npm run build. The full suite requires the @energy alias to resolve: temporarily materialize src/features/energy/domain from main (git show main:src/features/energy/domain/<file> into the path) and REMOVE it before finishing so it never enters a commit. New auth suites must be self-contained (no @energy).
snapshot_or_generated_files: none that get checked in; coverage/, dist/, .expo/, node_modules/, test-results/ are gitignored build artifacts and must NOT be committed
setup_instructions: cd apps/macros-web && npm install (deps @supabase/supabase-js and @tanstack/react-query already present). Node v20/v22 via nvm.
environment_constraints: Network OPEN_INTERNET. No live Supabase project in the sandbox, so real authentication cannot run; code stays correct and self-consistent and tests use a mocked supabase.auth client. The @energy domain is NOT on this branch (it lives on main) and must be temporarily materialized to run the pre-existing macros-wizard suites, then removed before any commit.
contribution_requirements: Conventional commits (feat/test/docs/chore). No console.log (ESLint no-console error). TypeScript strict, no any. Immutability. Many small files (200-400 lines typical, 800 max), functions < 50 lines. Reuse Enchanted/Cozy design tokens and auth UI primitives (FormCard, Button, AuthField); no new colors. Security: no hardcoded secrets, never log the password (keep redactCredentials), non-leaky error mapping, keep the documented localStorage XSS trade-off, no authorization logic in client that belongs to RLS.
key_patterns: Data layer pattern in src/features/macro-goals/macroGoals.data.ts: pure async functions take an injectable SupabaseClient<Database>, and a toClearError(context, error) wrapper that puts the raw provider error in `cause` and NEVER interpolates it into `message` (non-leaky). Tests mock the client (see macroGoals.data.test.ts) and assert raw details never appear in message. Hooks (useMacroGoal/useSaveMacroGoal) use TanStack Query (no useEffect for fetching) and already accept userId: string | null | undefined (query disabled until userId exists). Injectable logger + redactCredentials in src/features/auth/types.ts keep no-console green and never log the password. useAuthSubmit currently has a defaultSubmit that persists a placeholder token `session-<Date.now()>` via useAuthStorage; forms accept an injectable onSubmit?/onSuccess?. getSupabaseClient() is lazy+memoized and reads VITE_SUPABASE_URL/VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY; use its .auth for sign-in/up/out/getSession/onAuthStateChange.
directory_structure: apps/macros-web/src/features/auth/ (forms, useAuthSubmit, types, schemas/, storage/, components/AuthField, __tests__/); apps/macros-web/src/features/macro-goals/ (data + TanStack hooks + types + __tests__); apps/macros-web/src/lib/ (supabaseClient, env); apps/macros-web/src/data/database.types.ts (strict DB types); apps/macros-web/src/app/ (QueryProvider, queryClient); apps/macros-web/src/App.tsx and main.tsx are the roots.
